text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Luna

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Night falls on Palermo. The killers strike, but the doctor got there first. A new day dawns in Palermo, and nobody is out.

The game is over. The town wins. The roles were: Sonnet the officer, Haiku the doctor, Gemma the citizen, Sol the citizen, Luna the killer, Terra the killer.

Sonnet claimed to be the officer on day two and said Luna was a killer, while Luna countered with her own officer claim, which the town saw as too fast. The turning point came when Sol and Haiku pressed Luna on why she backed Terra, and Luna's dodging made her look guilty. Terra, the first killer, was voted out on day one after Sonnet pointed out how neatly she switched to Gemma once Luna was pressed. Luna was then voted out on day two, and the town won with Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, and Sol alive, while Luna and Terra were the killers.
